phases.name: drawTriangleComponent
phases.description: Draw the triangle component and its hit-flash colors.

phases.name: drawCircleComponent
phases.description: Draw the circle component with its fill and shaded outline.

phases.name: drawPlayerComponent
phases.description: Build player appearance parameters and dispatch its renderer.

phases.name: drawPetalComponent
phases.description: Create, bind and draw the catalog petal through its original virtual table.

phases.name: drawSpokedEffectComponent
phases.description: Build and cache the spoked effect path, then draw its fading image.

phases.name: drawRenderComponent
phases.description: Dispatch the first present render component in original priority order.

phases.name: isOutsideViewport
phases.description: Update visual bounds and test the expanded viewport.

phases.name: beginEntityDraw
phases.description: Save the drawing state, read the frame clock and retain the visual update timestamp.

phases.name: applyEntityLocalTransform
phases.description: Interpolate local position, constrain the player and compose translation and rotation.

phases.name: applyVisualFade
phases.description: Apply the flag-controlled visual fade and scale animation.

phases.name: drawOwnedChildren
phases.description: Find the owner range in the entity hash and recursively draw its children.

phases.name: trackNearbyEntityDiscovery
phases.description: Record a newly encountered nearby entity type using its resolved catalog identity.

phases.name: restoreEntityDrawingState
phases.description: Clear the visual update flag and restore the caller drawing state.

limitations: The complete body760 is recovered; remaining component renderers, math, discovery/string services, allocators and petal virtual functions remain explicit dependencies.
Unknown render component identities retain numeric entity offsets. The spoked effect is named after observed geometry; no product identity is claimed.
Host tests compare Canvas calls and state, not browser pixels. Finite packet/fixture cases do not prove every possible object graph or memory alias.
Browser validation is bound to recorded source/artifact hashes; see reports/current-verification.json and reports/runtime/readable.json.
dependencyClosureDefinition: Every statically reachable internal WASM body through direct calls is recovered; external host callback reentry is outside this graph, and any indirect-call site conservatively makes the result false.
